p: Abba Guryan of Tzadyan says in the name of Abba Gurya:
A person may not teach his son
a camel driver, … a pot maker, … a sailor,
a camel driver, a pot maker, a sailor,
as their trades are the trades of robbers;
Most donkey drivers are wicked, … and most camel drivers,
Most donkey drivers are wicked, since they engage in deceit, and most camel drivers,
The best of doctors is to Gehenna,
the fittest of butchers is a partner of Amalek.

p: I set aside all the trades in the world,

which is not true of other professions,
